In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 14.0 to 14.8 s. Overhead creek. The white car stays at the lower edge of the brown water for most of the second, with splash crescents at its right end; at 14.8 s it has moved a little to the left and is slightly rotated. Car underside sits about level with the caption box top; the car body itself is above the caption box.
